title: POST /api/pairing/clients/{client_id}/kids-override
description: Admin only: parent release of a child device (bedtime, rate limit and pauses off; blocked types, color lock, volume cap stay); also ends running pauses. Exactly one of minutes (15/30/60/120 in the admin UI, 1–240) or until = "bedtime_end" ("until tomorrow morning": end of the current or next bedtime of the device from its rule kids_quiet_hours in the hub time zone; without bedtime 07:00 local like the adjustment preset tomorrow_morning). DELETE = "lift pause": ends the release and every running pause. 409 not_child, 422 for neither (anyOf) and for both (hub check; the codegen subset cannot express "not both"). Answer: rest/kids-status.response.json.

until.description: Release until the end of the bedtime ("Until tomorrow morning").
